sources.title: AI-Powered Worm Leverages Stolen Compute to Target Linux ... - GBHackers
sources.snippet: AI-Powered Worm Leverages Devices In a recent lab evaluation from Arxiv, researchers built an AI-driven worm around a single open-weight LLM that runs locally on a compromised GPU, avoiding external model APIs that defenders could monitor or shut down. Once the worm compromises a GPU-equipped server, it deploys a local copy of the model.
